verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਕਛੁ ਬਸੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bachhuraa bilalaat maat milabe kau ba(n)dhan kai bas kachh bas na basaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a calf writhes and wriggles to meet his mother but tethered with rope makes him helpless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਭਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਕੀਓ ਪਰ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਹੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau bigaaree chaahai bhavan gavan keeo par bas pare chitavat hee bihaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a person caught in forced or unpaid labour wants to go home and spends time planning while remaining in other's control.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਚਾਹੇ ਲਾਜ ਕੁਲ ਅੰਕਸ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਬਲ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise birahanee pria sa(n)gam saneh chaahe laaj kul a(n)kas kai dhurabal gaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife separated from her husband wants love and union but cannot do so for fear of family shame and thus loses her physical attraction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਚਾਹੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਆਗਿਆ ਬਧ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur charan saran sukh chaahai sikh aagiaa badh rahat bidhes akulaat hai ||520||

en.bdb: Similarly a true disciple wants to enjoy the pleasures of the refuge of True Guru but bound by his command he wanders around dejectedly in another place.  (520)
